applied.fact: pitches = 1 on a 732 m multi-pitch ridge

before.overview: Four trad pitches. Begin with Dunlops Dangle's opening 5.8 pitch. Pitch 2 moves sideways, then ascends a face crack system (5.10) via a shallow chimney to a natural belay ledge; a 70 m rope links pitches 1 and 2. Pitch 3 runs a few meters further sideways, follows a face crack to a roof, crosses beneath it along a sloping ledge, and belays at a chimney's foot. Pitch 4 is that chimney. A large chockstone sits near its top; step left there, use 5.8 cracks, and finish over easy fourth-class terrain.
